from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudicialCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judicial document to support matching against outcome options."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case reference number (e.g., (2022) 京 0106 民初 13596 号)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court issuing the ruling")
    appellants: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of appellants or plaintiffs, as listed")
    applicants: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of applicants (in execution/review cases), as listed")
    defendants: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of respondents or defendants")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of procedure (e.g., Execution Objection, Civil Appeal, Criminal Review)")
    fee_amount: str | None = Field(description="Litigation fee amount if specified (e.g., '150 元', '11000 元')")
    decision_keywords: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Key phrases from the ruling's outcome section (e.g., '撤销', '维持原判', '移送')")
    transfer_target: str | None = Field(description="If case was transferred, the destination court name; else None")
    execution_amount: str | None = Field(description="Specific execution amount if modified or specified (e.g., '1217369.31 元')")
    criminal_statute: str | None = Field(description="Relevant criminal statute if it is a criminal case (e.g., '刑事诉讼法第二百五十三条')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[JudicialCase]
